compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: Complete data access layer rewrite required. All EDMX model files must be converted to EF Core Code-First or Database-First approach.
issues.description: Project uses EntityFramework 5.0.0 which is not compatible with .NET 8. This is a blocking issue.
issues.recommendation: Replace EntityFramework 5.0.0 with Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 8.0.0, and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 8.0.0. Migrate all DbContext classes, LINQ queries, and entity configurations to EF Core patterns.
issues.title: Entity Framework 5.0 Incompatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: Entire project file must be rewritten to SDK-style format. All references and build configuration need updating.
issues.description: Project targets .NET Framework 4.6 which must be upgraded to .NET 8
issues.recommendation: Convert project file to SDK-style format using <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web"> and set <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
issues.title: Target Framework .NET Framework 4.6

issues.codeSnippet: using System.Web; using System.Web.UI; using System.Web.UI.WebControls;
issues.impact: All code-behind files require refactoring to remove System.Web dependencies
issues.description: Found 76 System.Web references across 14 files. System.Web is not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace all System.Web references with ASP.NET Core equivalents: HttpContext.Current → IHttpContextAccessor, Page base class → PageModel, Response.Redirect → RedirectToPage
issues.title: System.Web References Throughout Codebase

issues.impact: Complete UI layer rewrite required. All Web Forms pages must be converted to Razor Pages with new architecture.
issues.description: Application has 5 .aspx pages that need migration to Razor Pages or MVC
issues.recommendation: Migrate each .aspx page to Razor Pages (.cshtml). Convert code-behind (Page class) to PageModel. Replace server controls with Tag Helpers or HTML helpers.
issues.title: Web Forms Pages Require Complete Rewrite

issues.impact: All page layouts must be redesigned using Razor Layout pages
issues.description: Found 2 master pages (Site.Master, Site.Mobile.Master) which have no direct equivalent in .NET 8
issues.recommendation: Convert master pages to Layout pages (_Layout.cshtml) in ASP.NET Core. ContentPlaceHolder controls become @RenderBody() and @RenderSection() directives.
issues.title: Master Pages Not Supported in .NET 8

issues.impact: User controls must be rewritten as Partial Views or View Components
issues.description: User control (.ascx) found which needs conversion to Partial View or View Component
issues.recommendation: Convert to Partial View (_ViewSwitcher.cshtml) or View Component depending on complexity. Remove code-behind logic and move to View Component if needed.
issues.title: User Control (ViewSwitcher.ascx) Requires Migration

issues.impact: Complete authentication and session management redesign required
issues.description: Web.config contains Forms Authentication, Membership, Profile, and Session configuration that don't exist in .NET 8
issues.recommendation: Migrate to appsettings.json for configuration. Replace Forms Authentication with ASP.NET Core Identity. Remove membership/profile providers and implement Identity. Configure session state using AddSession() in Program.cs.
issues.title: Web.config Must Migrate to appsettings.json

issues.impact: Complete authentication system rewrite required. User tables and authentication logic must be migrated to ASP.NET Core Identity.
issues.description: Application uses Forms Authentication which must be replaced with ASP.NET Core Identity
issues.recommendation: Install Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0, create IdentityDbContext, configure Identity services in Program.cs, migrate user tables to Identity schema
issues.title: Forms Authentication Not Supported

issues.codeSnippet: void Application_Start(object sender, EventArgs e) { BundleConfig.RegisterBundles(BundleTable.Bundles); AuthConfig.RegisterOpenAuth(); RouteConfig.RegisterRoutes(RouteTable.Routes); }
issues.impact: Application initialization logic must be completely rewritten using minimal hosting model
issues.description: Global.asax.cs contains application startup code (BundleConfig, AuthConfig, RouteConfig) that must migrate to Program.cs
issues.recommendation: Move all application startup logic to Program.cs using WebApplicationBuilder. Replace bundling with built-in static file serving or use WebOptimizer. Remove Global.asax entirely.
issues.title: Global.asax Not Supported in .NET 8

issues.impact: All entity models and database context must be regenerated for EF Core
issues.description: Project uses Entity Framework EDMX (Models/FilmsData.edmx) which is not supported in EF Core
issues.recommendation: Convert EDMX model to EF Core Code-First or Database-First. Create entity classes manually or scaffold from database using dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold. Create DbContext configuration.
issues.title: EDMX Model File Requires Migration

issues.impact: Asset bundling and minification approach must be redesigned
issues.description: Package Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization is .NET Framework-only and not compatible with .NET 8
issues.recommendation: Replace with built-in static file serving in ASP.NET Core or use WebOptimizer NuGet package for bundling and minification. Remove BundleConfig.cs.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization Not Compatible

issues.impact: External OAuth authentication must be completely rewritten using ASP.NET Core authentication middleware
issues.description: Multiple DotNetOpenAuth packages (4.1.4) are .NET Framework-only
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core Identity external authentication providers (Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Google, Facebook, Twitter, etc.) version 8.0.0
issues.title: DotNetOpenAuth Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: All validation logic must be rewritten using Data Annotations or FluentValidation
issues.description: Pages use ASP.NET validation controls (RequiredFieldValidator, RegularExpressionValidator) which don't exist in .NET 8
issues.recommendation: Replace with Data Annotations validation ([Required], [RegularExpression]) and Fluent Validation. Use Tag Helpers for client-side validation.
issues.title: Server-Side Validation Controls

issues.impact: UI conditional logic must be rewritten using Razor syntax and CSS
issues.description: Application uses asp:Panel controls for show/hide logic which need alternative implementation
issues.recommendation: Replace with div elements and conditional rendering using @if statements in Razor. Use CSS classes for visibility control or JavaScript for dynamic show/hide.
issues.title: Panel Controls Used for Conditional Display

issues.impact: Login UI components must be rewritten using Razor and ASP.NET Core Identity
issues.description: Site.Master uses LoginView and LoginStatus controls which are Web Forms-specific
issues.recommendation: Replace with Razor conditional logic checking User.Identity.IsAuthenticated. Use partial views for anonymous/authenticated user display.
issues.title: LoginView and LoginStatus Controls

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Page_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: Page initialization logic must be rewritten using Razor Pages lifecycle methods
issues.description: Found 9 Page_Load event handlers across code-behind files
issues.recommendation: Convert to PageModel OnGet/OnPost methods in Razor Pages or Controller actions in MVC. Move initialization logic to constructor or OnGetAsync methods.
issues.title: Page Lifecycle Event Handlers

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Button2_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: All form submission logic must be rewritten as HTTP POST handlers
issues.description: Multiple Button click event handlers (Button1_Click, Button2_Click, etc.) use postback pattern
issues.recommendation: Convert to form POST handlers in PageModel (OnPostAsync methods) or Controller actions. Use proper model binding and validation.
issues.title: Button Click Event Handlers (Postback Pattern)

issues.impact: State management strategy must be redesigned without ViewState
issues.description: Application uses ViewState which is not available in ASP.NET Core
issues.recommendation: Replace ViewState with TempData for temporary data, hidden fields, or client-side state management (localStorage, sessionStorage). For page state, use proper model binding.
issues.title: ViewState Usage Detected

issues.impact: Session state configuration must be rewritten in Program.cs
issues.description: Application uses InProc session state which requires migration
issues.recommendation: Configure session using builder.Services.AddSession() in Program.cs. For distributed scenarios, use AddDistributedMemoryCache() or Redis cache.
issues.title: Session State Configuration

issues.impact: Navigation logic needs minor refactoring to use ASP.NET Core redirection methods
issues.description: Code uses Response.Redirect which needs migration
issues.recommendation: Replace with return Redirect() in PageModel or Controller. For pages, use return RedirectToPage(). For external URLs, use Redirect(url).
issues.title: Response.Redirect Usage

issues.impact: AJAX functionality must be rewritten using modern client-side approaches
issues.description: Project references AjaxControlToolkit 16.1.1.0 which is Web Forms-specific
issues.recommendation: Replace with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries (jQuery, Vue.js, React, Alpine.js) for AJAX functionality. Use partial views with AJAX helpers or fetch API.
issues.title: AjaxControlToolkit Not Compatible

issues.impact: Client-side script management must be redesigned
issues.description: ScriptManager packages are Web Forms-specific and not compatible with .NET 8
issues.recommendation: Remove ScriptManager references. Use standard script tags or bundling solutions for JavaScript management. Replace UpdatePanel with AJAX fetch calls and partial view updates.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.ScriptManager Not Compatible

issues.impact: URL routing must be configured using ASP.NET Core routing
issues.description: FriendlyUrls package is Web Forms-specific
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core routing configured in Program.cs using MapRazorPages() or MapControllerRoute(). Use route constraints and parameters.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.FriendlyUrls Not Compatible

issues.impact: Membership and provider infrastructure must be replaced with ASP.NET Core equivalents
issues.description: System.Web.Providers package provides membership/session providers for .NET Framework only
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core Identity for membership and built-in session providers for session state. Remove all System.Web.Providers references.
issues.title: System.Web.Providers Not Compatible

issues.impact: Script management approach must be updated
issues.description: Site.Master uses asp:ScriptManager which is Web Forms-specific
issues.recommendation: Remove ScriptManager. Add JavaScript references directly in layout page using <script> tags or use a bundling solution. Move script references to _Layout.cshtml.
issues.title: ScriptManager Control in Master Page

issues.impact: Connection strings must be reformatted for EF Core
issues.description: Connection string uses EF6 metadata format which is incompatible with EF Core
issues.recommendation: Convert to standard SQL Server connection string format. Remove metadata references. Update connection string in appsettings.json: "Server=DESKTOP-52UDVT7\FILIP;Database=films;Integrated Security=True;"
issues.title: Entity Framework Connection String Format

issues.impact: All entity classes must be regenerated and may require property adjustments
issues.description: Models generated from EDMX need to be recreated for EF Core
issues.recommendation: Scaffold entities from database using 'dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold' or create Code-First entity classes. Add DbSet properties to DbContext. Create entity configurations using IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>.
issues.title: Entity Framework Models Require Regeneration

issues.impact: Interactive controls must use client-side JavaScript instead of server-side postbacks
issues.description: CheckBox uses AutoPostBack=True which relies on ViewState and postback
issues.recommendation: Replace with JavaScript event handlers and AJAX calls. Use onchange events to update UI without full page reload. Implement using fetch API or jQuery AJAX.
issues.title: AutoPostBack Pattern Used

issues.impact: Project file must be completely rewritten in new format
issues.description: Project uses legacy .csproj format with extensive ItemGroup declarations
issues.recommendation: Convert to SDK-style project format. Remove explicit file inclusions (files are included by convention). Simplify project file to minimal configuration.
issues.title: Old-Style Project File Format

issues.impact: Configuration access pattern must change to use IConfiguration
issues.description: Web.config contains connection strings and app settings that need migration
issues.recommendation: Create appsettings.json with ConnectionStrings section. Create appsettings.Development.json for development-specific settings. Use IConfiguration for accessing settings.
issues.title: AppSettings and ConnectionStrings Migration

issues.impact: Layout placeholder pattern must use Razor sections
issues.description: Master page uses ContentPlaceHolder which needs conversion
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor sections using @RenderSection("FeaturedContent", required: false) in _Layout.cshtml. Update child pages to use @section FeaturedContent { }.
issues.title: ContentPlaceHolder Controls

issues.impact: Server controls must be replaced with HTML elements and Tag Helpers
issues.description: Pages use asp:Image control which needs conversion
issues.recommendation: Replace with standard HTML tag or use for cache busting.
issues.title: Image Control Usage

issues.impact: Button controls must be converted to standard HTML form elements
issues.description: Application uses asp:Button controls for form submission
issues.recommendation: Replace with HTML <button type="submit"> or <input type="submit"> elements. Use Tag Helpers if needed for additional functionality.
issues.title: Button Server Controls

issues.impact: TextBox controls must be replaced with HTML input elements and Tag Helpers
issues.description: Forms use asp:TextBox controls which need conversion
issues.recommendation: Replace with HTML <input> elements or use <input asp-for="PropertyName" /> Tag Helpers with proper model binding.
issues.title: TextBox Server Controls

issues.impact: Label controls should be replaced with HTML elements or Razor syntax
issues.description: Application uses asp:Label controls for dynamic text display
issues.recommendation: Replace with standard HTML elements (<span>, <label>, <div>) or use @Model.PropertyName for dynamic content in Razor Pages.
issues.title: Label Server Controls

issues.impact: Routing configuration must be rewritten using ASP.NET Core routing
issues.description: Application uses RouteConfig class for routing configuration
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core endpoint routing in Program.cs: app.MapRazorPages() for Razor Pages or app.MapControllerRoute() for MVC.
issues.title: RouteConfig.RegisterRoutes Pattern

issues.impact: Asset bundling and optimization strategy must be redesigned
issues.description: Application uses Web Optimization bundling
issues.recommendation: Replace with built-in static file serving or use WebOptimizer package. Configure in Program.cs: app.UseStaticFiles(). For bundling, consider using LibMan or npm.
issues.title: BundleConfig for Asset Management

issues.impact: JavaScript dependencies must be updated and tested
issues.description: Application uses jQuery 1.8.2 which is very old and has security vulnerabilities
issues.recommendation: Upgrade to jQuery 3.x (latest stable) or consider modern alternatives like Alpine.js or vanilla JavaScript. Update all jQuery code for compatibility.
issues.title: jQuery 1.8.2 Very Outdated

issues.impact: Feature detection library should be updated or removed
issues.description: Application uses outdated version of Modernizr
issues.recommendation: Update to Modernizr 3.x or evaluate if it's still needed. Modern browsers have better CSS feature detection built-in.
issues.title: Modernizr 2.6.2 Outdated

issues.impact: Cosmetic improvement, optional during migration
issues.description: Project name is 'FIlms' with capital I instead of 'Films'
issues.recommendation: Consider renaming to 'Films' with proper casing during migration for better readability. Update all namespace references.
issues.title: Project Name Has Inconsistent Casing

issues.impact: Optional localization support for internationalization
issues.description: Application has hardcoded Bulgarian text which may need localization
issues.recommendation: Consider implementing localization using IStringLocalizer and resource files if multi-language support is needed.
issues.title: Bulgarian Text in UI

issues.codeSnippet: Multiple jQuery UI CSS and image files
issues.impact: Static files must be moved to wwwroot and references updated
issues.description: Application includes jQuery UI theme files which need migration
issues.recommendation: Copy static files to wwwroot folder. Update references to use ~ path or relative paths. Configure static file serving in Program.cs.
issues.title: jQuery UI Theme Files

issues.codeSnippet: void Application_Error(object sender, EventArgs e) { // Code that runs when an unhandled error occurs }
issues.impact: Error handling must use ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline
issues.description: Global.asax has empty Application_Error handler
issues.recommendation: Implement exception handling using exception middleware: app.UseExceptionHandler() and app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage(). Configure error pages.
issues.title: Application_Error Event Handler

issues.impact: UI should be redesigned with modern CSS and semantic HTML
issues.description: Pages use table-based layouts which are not accessible
issues.recommendation: Migrate to CSS-based layouts using flexbox or grid. Use semantic HTML5 elements. Ensure WCAG 2.1 compliance.
issues.title: Missing HTML5 Semantic Elements

issues.impact: Code cleanup recommended during migration
issues.description: Multiple files contain commented-out code and configuration
issues.recommendation: Remove commented code during migration. Use source control for history. Clean up and modernize during rewrite.
issues.title: Commented Code and Settings

issues.impact: Complete architectural redesign recommended for maintainability
issues.description: Business logic mixed with UI code in code-behind files
issues.recommendation: Implement clean architecture with separate layers: Domain (entities), Application (services, DTOs), Infrastructure (data access), Web (UI). Use dependency injection.
issues.title: No Separation of Concerns

issues.impact: Testing infrastructure should be established during migration
issues.description: Project has no unit test or integration test projects
issues.recommendation: Create test projects during migration: [ProjectName].UnitTests and [ProjectName].IntegrationTests. Use xUnit, FluentAssertions, and Moq for testing.
issues.title: No Unit Tests Present

recommendations: Begin migration by setting up new .NET 8 solution structure with clean architecture (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Web layers). This provides foundation for all subsequent work.
Migrate Entity Framework 5.0 to EF Core 8.0 as first priority. Scaffold entities from database or convert EDMX to Code-First. Create DbContext, entity configurations, and repository interfaces.
Implement ASP.NET Core Identity to replace Forms Authentication. Migrate user data schema. Create login, registration, and account management pages using Razor Pages.
Convert all 5 .aspx pages to Razor Pages. Start with simplest pages (About, Contact) then tackle complex pages (LogIn, Register). Convert master pages to _Layout.cshtml.
Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json. Set up Program.cs with proper middleware pipeline. Configure dependency injection, logging, and session state.
Extract business logic from code-behind files into service layer. Create DTOs for data transfer. Implement repository pattern for data access.
Move all static files to wwwroot folder. Update jQuery to 3.x. Replace bundling with modern approach (WebOptimizer or LibMan). Update script and CSS references.
Create unit test and integration test projects. Write tests for services, repositories, and page handlers. Aim for 80%+ code coverage on business logic.
Replace server-side validation controls with Data Annotations and FluentValidation. Implement client-side validation using jQuery Validation or native HTML5 validation.
Set up CI/CD pipeline for .NET 8 application. Create Dockerfile for containerization. Document deployment process and environment configuration.
